title: Complete cheat library: usable alternatives, later native card evidence and world-relative standing
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: full palette review / later implementation chronology / historical default qualifiers
reviews.disposition:
Full owner-content reconciliation under AD5/AD8/AD10–AD20/AD22/AD29/AD32/AD36/AD38/AD42/AD43/AD51/AD52. All1712 pre-fold lines were read in consecutive150-line slices through1650 and final62. This covers49 initial family rows,13 numbered player-mechanic cards, AQ1–AQ14, US1–US6/ST11–ST17, SW/UP/RS/WR/LB/CT, S1/S1P/S1U/S1V/S1S, AW/DM/S1D/QG/QT/PT/SC/IN/GL, MN/ML/MI/ME/MW/OS, PF/TR/CA/FR/SL/LA/PE/LE, SH1–SH26/OV/SE/II, CSW/AB/LW and A suggestions, all AUDIT/R1/W4/W5/TE/MX/LQ/IA/AB returns, IM1–IM46/D4/G1 and B7/B121/B132/B136/B396 folds. Family/card counts are checked in library-table-check-b499.json; aliases/source mappings are not independent ready implementations. Earlier selected-range notes are superseded for coverage by this actual full read, not retroactively enlarged. No linked private/source/code/report body is credited as newly read.

Authority and current scope. Preserve the user's cheat-as-gameplay/library interest, actual title/rule-target direction, optional start/rarity questions and all later source-local decisions separately from agent proposals. Early first-three-card, C0–C6, CH1-first, stage1-first, two-users-before-seam and BUILD NEXT sequences are historical suggestions. Current PROJECT lead-first work, deferred wider cheat work and heirs as distinct starts govern. AD51 allows the first useful shared seam; expected future consumers are not implemented users and no giant universal card/fact/message engine is required first. AD52 supports long-play compression through actual owners, not a script that skips unpaid effects. The illustrative module/table schemas, old main line counts and source observations are not current architectural authority.

Library cards and new loops. Every initial family and later CT/SH/player card stays a usable palette without requiring every cheat to add a screen, points, new resource, tell, counter, cost or progression arc. Quiet passives, active-at-birth, fixed, fully understood and overwhelmingly effective powers remain possible. Their users can develop new purposes, uses, relationships or combinations while power stays fixed. Ordinary maps, inventory, known records, save controls and truthful actionable UI need not be locked behind an extraordinary ability. A supernatural preview, private feeling, hidden-property read, genuine rewind or exact future needs its actual mechanism/consumer. Losing a source need not erase independently retained knowledge, body change, property or every loop it helped establish.

Enemies and consequences. Same-family policy is not identical desire or a mandatory enemy progression schedule. A regressor need not keep retrying until victory, every clone need not have one core, and a diviner may genuinely see through randomness if its means support it. An early holder can be overwhelmingly strong; later years/boundaries do not automatically level one up without actual support/time policy. Every reveal/tell/counter/hunter/scar/jealousy/patch/backlash line is a possible local consequence, not compulsory fairness or balancing. A free perfect copier or lucky strategy can remove work and remain legitimate under AD22/AD38. Actual observers, goals, reach and causes govern response. Ordinary enemies and rescue/recruitment possibilities remain available without turning all holders into player-facing puzzles.

Carriers and death. Item drop, soul return, new system host, hereditary bloodline and patron reassignment are alternatives requiring surviving actual carriers/terms, not guaranteed outcomes of their category. A carried design can preserve knowledge without materials/body execution; an account/issuer, physical book, institution's rights and a soul are different owners. A backup/profile/player seed is not automatically a character faculty. An heir is a distinct person unless a real selected mechanism carries the continuing self. Knowledge, conditioning, aptitude, reserves, held items, debt, rights and another actor's memory must not be copied as one whole bundle. A real world-deed effect may remain local or propagate through a supported link; it is not necessarily known to everyone. Old one-anchor, day, quota/slot and recursion limits are source/local dials rather than global once-only rules.

Thirteen player-mechanic examples. Keep Echo Anchor's reset scope/order, Furnace's actual routine/time-bank versus real absence, Compact's surviving estate/claims, Pattern Book's learned design versus execution, Cartographer's layout/knowledge, Rebirth Ledger's selected accounting, Instinct's real memory/body carrier, Habit's learned routine, Steward's actual event influence, Dice's committed result, Hall's distinct selves and Deeds' true recipient/world state separate. These cards need not all be costly, smaller than undo-everything, non-social, capped, vulnerable or restricted to a weak first form. Source-derived daily/offline figures remain historical game observations, not fresh product specs or YAIR defaults. Hour50 tests and meaningful-ordinary-work wishes are design taste, not universal acceptance gates or reasons to weaken a genuine powerful premise.

Equivalence Ledger. The stated25% deposit/withdraw spread yields0.75/1.25=60% buying power on the same tariff before rounding, but actual market/credit cycles and zero-fee routes are not proven by a recipe DAG. B121 already qualifies cannot-mint and always-worse-than-merchant claims. Issuer tariff versus actual market value, emitted goods versus finite stock, learned path versus actual sample/recipe, quality/identity/recognition and frozen quote compatibility remain concrete gaps. A book loss or issuer border does not automatically destroy an independently retained account. Its default rounding/no-splitting-gain, refusals and fees are selected candidate mechanics, not universal anti-profit/exchange restrictions. No anchor/pricing source data or spike code was reread here.

Starts and world-relative standing. The library's US/ST/RS8 and progression-guard rows were agent responses to a progression concern, not a ban on strong first-life/random/unlocked starts or on skipping redundant work with real means. Unlock, dormant, weak, costed, fully effective, cheat-free and creative routes remain different possibilities; AQ1's old first-build label is not today's queue. World-law/common/rare/forbidden/cheat standing separates baseline, prevalence, actual strength, social law and personal advantage. WR8's blanket no-universal-rank line conflicts with the user's retained ranking/equalization direction; corrected locally with old wording preserved. Genuine absolute scales and rank conversion can exist when the selected cosmology supplies them. Common powers can still be regulated, rare ones unnoticed, and travel may preserve their function rather than necessarily recalibrating them.

Information and disclosure. Preserve the later return corrections over early OV3/II2/SE4/AB6: precision, depth, interpretation, freshness and forecast are separate axes; retained historical reading keeps value/time/basis rather than live remote truth. Own native quantities remain truthful under AD8, while an actual lying or limited in-world system can have a distinct attributed account. Unknown counts/silhouettes and error/tooltip/ARIA/sort/price/ID leaks need a real discovery means; redacted text alone is insufficient. A peek does not advance draws, but saved seed/stream alone is not the complete future—eligible actions, state and draw order still matter. Real exact prophecy remains possible through its actual law. Source/card/evidence tags do not grant omniscience, current knowledge or all-body authority.

Quest, point and voice proposals. Real native progress, particular system objectives, offers, completion, manual/auto claim, durable grant and displayed receipt are distinct. No mandatory daily board, point cap, reroll tax, harsh attendance/expiry, forced chores or information-only early reward follows. A world can intentionally reward both an ordinary request and a system objective through separate real issuers; accidental double settlement is different. A cruel/deceptive fictional system can offer a trap while the application's actual commitments/stock/save feedback remains accurate. Quiet days, snooze, no guilt, settings and steady known targets remain useful examples. CA13 quiet-base direction does not require an evolving talking character, patron agenda, shop or staged temperament. Fulfilled old work, newly repeated work and already-done offers need their actual identity/baseline rather than a universal no-retroactivity rule.

Persistence, presentation and compaction. Commit-before-reveal, failed-write nonpublication, meaningful quote revalidation, one-owner claim identity, ordinary support-loss and genuine receipt are reusable distinctions, not a new universal phase scheduler or extra full suite. Seed/index alone may not preserve changed board definitions or old content revision; retain consequential admitted terms/results under the actual versioned owner. FR1/FR3 quarantine/reset are old candidate policies; later records preserve opaque raw entries and distinguish strict import/active card/unsupported envelope instead of silently resetting earned progress. No blanket permissive load, migration or new top-level quarantine is selected by this review. Backups retain restoring truth; human share summaries redact appropriately. Protect sealed output without unsolicited obfuscation/anti-cheat hardening of private user storage. Collapsed rendering can be cheap without pausing genuine hidden simulation. Clock/tick counts, world days, absence and banked time are not interchangeable.

Micro and comic choices. MN rounding/unit/source agreement, meaningful have/need, readable long terms, stable subject/focus, explicit Stop, no-spend preview and narrow live announcements remain useful. Do not move a pending click/key repeat to a new claim merely because a row reorders. Theme, plain voice, animation/chime and exact fixed string/line sizes are contextual dials under current desktop rules, not a mandate for every skin. ML retained first message/daily summaries do not replace consequential identity/terms with counts. II/AB's single stack, shared redactor and no-scan suggestions need the real existing consumer; an old dependency map is not a new framework gate. Retcon/sliding-time/status-quo/plot bars are possible declared comic mechanisms, not compulsory canon repair, universal metadata truth or automatic erasure of previous obligations. Changed physical truth versus retained observation needs its actual memory policy; no return/death prediction or compensation is granted by a show-card name.

Later reported implementation chronology. The October14 return table narrows many early new-build proposals, while D4/G1 reports bounded native delivery for quiet insight, optional finite quest system, carcass appraisal, loot-call Dice, visible-foe Ledger, finite Habit, RF1 rehearsal, readable Pattern Book, estate Compact, retained Freshness and OD4/TBANK Furnace. These supersede early blanket no-hook/no-holder/no-carry/no-rematch/no-offline-policy statements at their reported identities. They do not implement all49 families/324-or326 overlapping inventory rows; the326/13-family reconciliation is a different later inventory snapshot, not326 ready cards. RF1 rehearsed opening is not arbitrary enemy timeline rewind. Appraisal cannot silently lower a better reading; retained time is not re-observation. Logged receipt eviction cannot own or revoke a durable keyed result. Local module reserves differ from enduring learned development and actual target-snapshot stock. Existing continuation owners, not a duplicate card reset engine, perform boundary transitions.

Remaining gaps and proof. D4's unused overlay/NPC families, broader share-summary redactor, dev inspector and source-specific PC variants retain their selected source/policy/consumer questions. B7's inspected applyStartGrants source wiring is not an earned ring-elder/unreliable-voice/native-persistence route; IM36 dormant code need not activate during a deferred task. B132/B136/B396 preserve later corrections and optional powerful/carrier routes. Full legacy library reading does not renew the original source inspections,26 RF1 tests, browser/heir/import results or failed-full/targeted-repair gate, and no current code/build/installer/save artifact was inspected. Current runtime claims need their real producers/state/consumers and AD36/AD43 proof, with human review optional AD42. Keep all useful alternatives here, reopen a selected actual world/consumer seam under current direction, and add no new worker, source wave, gameplay/schema/UI implementation, commit or publication from this document reconciliation.
